Maya (Finance): AcmeCloud sent a new price sheet: +12% on embedding credits effective 2025-05-01 and changed invoice unit id to `emb_credit_unit`. This will break recon. Need mapping, grandfathering for prepaid bundles, and a short A/B.

Tom (Revenue Ops): Suggest A/B for new signups only. Flag `acme_new_pricing`: canary 5% -> 50/50 for 14 days -> full. Track $/embedding, 7/14/30d retention, churn, invoice failures.

Anil (Billing Eng): I'll add ingestion alias mapping `emb_credit_unit` -> `emb_credits` and a transform to surface unmapped units. Will open PR with integration test and rollback runbook. ETA tomorrow.

billing-bot: Alert: Acme invoice 2025-04-18 failed schema validation (missing unit_code). Link: https://billing.example.com/ingest/alerts/1776550011 :warning:

Maya (Finance): Finance asks: revenue recognition guidance for uplift on prepaid bundles, and final cohort list for grandfathering. Proposal: preserve current per-unit price for active paid subs through 2025-07-01, then staged migration.

Priya (Legal): Draft amendment. Need opt-out mechanics and notice period; confirm if vendor requires signed amendment or email confirmation. Can review draft by EOD Fri if received today.

Dana (Product): Need final price table and cohort export. UI should show changes on billing pages only for affected customers. Avoid surfacing experiment broadly.

Tom (Revenue Ops): We'll maintain `acme_exempt_customers` tag for enterprise negotiations and export for Sales. Guardrails: halt if invoice failure +0.5pp or churn delta >2%.

Anil (Billing Eng): PR will include mapping monitor alert (fail if mapping <99.5%) and replay job for failed invoices.

Maya (Finance): Recap: Anil PR+runbook (tomorrow), Tom flag+dashboard (Mon), Priya amendment (Fri), Dana cohort+UI (Mon), Finance revenue recog sign-off (Thu). Scheduling vendor sync Wed 10am PT.

Tom (Revenue Ops): I'll add A/B analysis sheet and gating thresholds before canary.

Maya (Finance): I'll update pricing experiment doc once cohorts locked. Thanks everyone.
